diffuseAlbedo.source: Palette.json: accent.porphyry realMaterial (porfido rosso antico, Mons Porphyrites; reclaimed)
diffuseAlbedo.note: A deep purple-red groundmass (fine hematite) flecked with pale pink plagioclase, averaged over a face; read from photographs of Roman roundels until a specimen is measured.

refractiveIndex.source: Palette.json: accent.porphyry realMaterial (porfido rosso antico, Mons Porphyrites; reclaimed)
refractiveIndex.note: Its phenocrysts and groundmass are chiefly plagioclase feldspar, with indices near 1.55; no measurement of the stone was read. It is the one stone of the Hall that is not calcite.

porosity.source: Palette.json: accent.porphyry realMaterial (porfido rosso antico, Mons Porphyrites; reclaimed)
porosity.note: A dense volcanic rock, under one per cent open porosity; no measured value was read.

wettingDepth.source: Palette.json: accent.porphyry realMaterial (porfido rosso antico, Mons Porphyrites; reclaimed)
wettingDepth.note: A dense igneous stone takes water only into its outer half-millimetre; no measured depth was read.

grain.source: Palette.json: accent.porphyry realMaterial (porfido rosso antico, Mons Porphyrites; reclaimed)
grain.note: The pale feldspar phenocrysts, a few millimetres long, that make a porphyry.

bed.source: Palette.json: accent.porphyry realMaterial (porfido rosso antico, Mons Porphyrites; reclaimed)
bed.note: The clusters the phenocrysts gather in; a porphyry has no bedding.

bedAspect.source: Palette.json: accent.porphyry realMaterial (porfido rosso antico, Mons Porphyrites; reclaimed)
bedAspect.note: An igneous rock is isotropic: no drawn-out direction.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.source: Palette.json: accent.porphyry realMaterial (porfido rosso antico, Mons Porphyrites; reclaimed)
toneSpread.note: Pale phenocrysts on a deep purple groundmass.

roughnessSpread.source: Workings/honed.json: unverified surface.microRoughness (no filtered roughness read)
roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across a worked face, as the travertine's.
